board: LM393 sound detection sensor module, common blue MH-sensor-series / FC-04 3-pin board (OUT, GND, VCC)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico on the first run. The part is a digital-sensor with OUT active LOW: OUT goes low on sound, and the LM393 open-collector output is pulled up to VCC on the board. The driver watches OUT over a time window, because on real hardware OUT pulses with the sound wave rather than staying low.
